title: Enter If You Dare! WNY's Most Haunted Spots
excerpt: Here are some of the most haunted spots in Western New York
content:
We are in creepy season in Western New York and if you are looking for a chance to meet a real ghost, there are some spots in the 716 you need to check out.

Most Haunted Spots In Western New York

Some people believe in spirits and ghosts, and if you are one of those people, there are some places in Western New York known to be "haunted".

One of the spots is the 13th floor in the Rand Building. This is the former home to a couple of Townsquare Media radio stations, and the rumor was that there was a ghost of a woman, who was dressed in red, was seen by several employees during late-night and overnight hours.

I will say that during my time there, I never saw her, but several of my co-workers swore they had, and she would float down the hallway.

Some of the other most "haunted" spots in Western New York include:

The Statler Hotel

Iron Island Museum

The Buffalo Central Terminal

Rolling Hills Asylum

Haunted Tours Available in Western New York

If you want a guided tour and stories of ghosts in Western New York, you can take a tour and save some money. Mason Winfield is an author, researcher, and one of Upstate New York's leading paranormal scholars, and he offers haunted tours and pub crawls.

Some of the tours that he offers include:

  • Allentown: Eerie legends from one of Buffalo's oldest and most distinctive neighborhoods.
  • Larkinville: The area's industrial past and the folklore that grew from it.
  • Williamsville: The haunted history of this historic village.
  • Buffalo's Theater District: Mysterious stories from the city's historic entertainment district.
  • Buffalo's Old First Ward: The newest tour, exploring the history and legends of this storied neighborhood
